summary: Indexes are still slightly lower after the hot CPI and rising December hike bets, with chips split: Nvidia extended its slide (about -5%, under Monday's 170.24 low) while AMD rallied about 4%. Changes: the AMD put was stopped out and flipped to a call, HIMS hit its put target (-15%) and was swapped for a Rocket Lab put, NVDA levels lowered; quote pages were blocked, so prices are estimates from news snippets.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 5% and through Monday's 170.24 low on the .5B China-shipments report and FBI scrutiny of Huang; losing 166.50 opens the 164.27 52-week low (price estimated).

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Up about 4% after Monday's 13% Oppenheimer-upgrade surge as money rotates out of Nvidia into AMD; a push through 535 extends the trend (price estimated).

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Holding its earnings gap on GTA VI preorders ahead of the Nov 19 launch; a push through 219.50 extends the trend (price estimated, no fresh quote).

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: S&P bought back most of the hot-CPI gap to about -0.1%; reclaiming Monday's 753 close turns the day green, losing the opening low near 747.50 resumes the fade.

picks.name: Rocket Lab
picks.reason: Wider Q3 loss and Neutron slipping to 2027 have it down about 6%; a break of Monday's 53.01 low extends the selloff (price estimated).

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq erased a 1.2% loss to about flat despite Nvidia's drop; over 681 extends the reversal, under 672 retests the lows.
